name: The apex-weld seam law: hangers weld only at apexes, reflected about (hA + h)/2, seam owned by the ground piece

law_spec.placement: hanger reflection z -> (hA + h) - z; reduces to assembly 1's transform for hangers with h = hA (byte-identical reuse)
law_spec.ownership: one seam vertex, owned by the ground piece, referenced by every hanger; deduplicated

physical_definition.topology: any connected assembly of fan patches is a single-seam star (one grounded piece + k inverted hangers); two-seam chains cannot exist
excluded_phenomena: rim welds (witness (g): free seam rings have no equilibrium, residual ~1.08)
seam coordinate mismatch above 1e-12 (refused before any solve)

ports.patch_geometry: one shared seam vertex; the opposing films' pull balances the transferred load (real port transfer)
ports.local_frame: vertical axis at the seam apex
ports.sign_convention: transfer measured by the port net reaction norms
ports.work_accounting: port transfer measured via block mean reaction norms (margin 0.488 in the star)

instance_state.owner: piece_record layer; the law is immutable, shared by every assembly record citing it

representations.note: qualified twice: assembly 1 (0.5x/1.0x/2.0x) and the byte-identical-reuse star (1.0x/0.75x)

measured_response_anchors.values: 0.488 block margin; port nets 0.922/0.737 N at 1.0x

function_card.operating_domain: fan-patch assemblies whose pieces each have exactly one apex

costs.weld: placement reflection + index remap; no extra solve cost

failures: rim-weld chains: structurally impossible (witness (g), recorded in composed receipts)

fabrication_binding.required_material: as for the pieces it joins
exclusions: every seam topology other than apex welds (witness (g))
fabrication_binding.physical_to_render: unset: no engine binding exists yet
